title: Marker Token Grammar
description: The marker-token module implements the @kaava: prefix pattern matching.
body: The marker-token grammar (PRD `SCHEMATIFY-PRD.md` section 9.1): found by plain regular expression rather than parsed as a doc comment, because a docstring parser breaks on the first language nobody anticipated. The UUID is authoritative; the trailing slug is a human grep aid and carries no semantics reconciliation depends on. A malformed candidate simply does not match. There is no separate malformed token outcome; a near-miss is invisible to the scanner.
